note: A strict build over register 1 (#1736, #584). Variables 8 and 9 share the source name 'Utbildningsinriktning' and the operational definition 'Inriktning enligt SUN', so the definition steps are skipped and each takes its own column: '(SUN2000Inr)' and '(SUN2020Inr)'. They are classification-edition siblings: 8 binds book sun2000-inriktning, 9 binds sun2020-inriktning, and relations.toml chains the two editions in 2020. The vintage lift keys a family on the source name the ladder replaced, so the ladder names do not split the family and 8 -> 9 is lifted in 2020.
fails_if: the vintage lift keys its families on the ladder name instead of the source name it replaced, so the renamed siblings fall into two families and the lifted 8 -> 9 edge is lost (the regression that took a real-seed build from 81 lift edges to 0); or the ladder stops renaming the siblings (both are refused as duplicate_variable_name)

sources.description: Variable 8 delivers SUN2000Inr in 2000 under the value-set version 'SUN 2000 Inriktning', variable 9 SUN2020Inr in 2020 under 'SUN 2020 Inriktning', both named 'Utbildningsinriktning' with the operational definition 'Inriktning enligt SUN' and the one code 1.
